scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend lint && cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy .
scripts.test: pnpm --filter frontend test && cd backend && uv run pytest
scripts.gen:api: cd backend && uv run python -m app.export_openapi && cd .. && openapi-typescript backend/openapi.json -o frontend/src/lib/api/schema.d.ts
